scenes.name: Arrival
scenes.job: Where are we, and what is the question? A living meadow at golden hour hides something.
scenes.begin: the whole meadow from above, a river, a village, a mill
scenes.middle: down at the edge of the cut, eye on the grass, into the sun

shots.why: open: the whole meadow from above, so we know where we are before we go under it
change of scale: from the map down to the grass at the edge of the cut, into the low sun; the title lands here

scenes.name: The young layers
scenes.job: What is just under the turf? The recent past, one layer at a time.
scenes.begin: the treetops and the river glass
scenes.middle: the mole, the chest and the Roman jar appear as the narration names them
scenes.end: the camera rests at the Roman layer

shots.why: the reveal: the cut face read from the top down, each find on the word that names it

scenes.name: Deep time
scenes.job: How deep does time go? Down to the giant in the stone.
scenes.middle: the years roll into millions as the camera sinks
scenes.end: close on the skull of the giant

shots.why: new information: the layers below are millions of years old; the camera keeps sinking past the fossils
change of scale: the payoff, close on the skull of the giant

scenes.name: Back on top
scenes.job: What does it change? The quiet meadow again, now we know what is under it.
scenes.begin: low on the meadow, the sun behind it
scenes.middle: a slow arc, the light bursting round the big tree

shots.why: the consequence: back to the whole world, rim-lit, for the closing line and the end card
